mu_name_from: _enum.h:1587 MODEL_DIVINE_CB_OF_ARCHANGEL = MODEL_BOW + 18, loaded from Item/Bow19.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:699), a crossbow by CharacterManager.cpp:81; group 4 number 18 in OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:234.
why_this_one: The third Statue of Saint (134) carries it over its coffin, at scale 0.9 where the other two are 0.7 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:8952-8966; WebZen raises one of the three statues at random, BloodCastle.cpp:2216), and gives it up when broken; carried back to the Archangel it wins the castle, as the Divine Staff does. A weapon that drops in Icarus as well (stats.note). docs/worlds/blood-castle-port.md.

stats.from: OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:234: CreateWeapon(4, 18, 0, 24, 2, 3, false, "Divine Crossbow of Archangel", 100, 224, 246, 45, 200, 0, 0, 40, 110, ...) -- drop 100, 224-246, speed 45, elf.
stats.note: A real weapon again since 2026-10-10 (the user: 'allow to drops archangel weapons, i guess starting on icarus', 'make theam dropable items and place there drop there they logciallly can start to drop'), replacing the quest-item rule of 2026-10-03: MU's own row, wearable by its classes, sold and dropped as any weapon. It drops from its drop level up, which puts it in Icarus (Drakan 86, Great Drakan 100, the Dark Phoenix 108) and Tarkan's deepest. Blood Castle's Statue of Saint still gives one up and the Archangel still takes a plain one back (Realm::staffSlot). drops_from_monsters is ours: OpenMU and WebZen keep it off the drop table.

stance_from: A crossbow by MU's own range test (CharacterManager.cpp:81, MODEL_DIVINE_CB_OF_ARCHANGEL to MODEL_GREAT_REIGN_CROSSBOW).
sheet_from: Data/Item/crossbow06_R.OZJ (32x64, the red crystal limbs, 112 triangles) and crossbow06.OZJ (16x64, the blue steel stock, 98). Decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_note: As the Divine Staff's: steel, the paint its albedo. Built 2026-10-10: mesh 0's RENDER_METAL under its sliding Chrome01 is the chrome pass (chrome_from); its held sparkles are commented out in MuMain (ZzzCharacter.cpp:7523-7539); fired, it would loose MODEL_ARROW_BEST_CROSSBOW (ZzzEffectMagicSkill.cpp:231), which a quest item never is. A statue holds it at scale 0.9, AngleMatrix(10, 0, 0) and (0, 110, 80) (ZzzCharacter.cpp:6684-6699).
rig_note: Bow19.rig.json since 2026-10-10 (muextract export-rig --actions=all), as the Bluewing's: one bone and one action of one key, nothing moves, but the rig is what seats a crossbow in the hand. Without it, left out while this was a quest item nobody held, it was dressed as a sword would be and could not be seen in the elf's hands (the user: 'did not see arch crosbow on elf hands'). Still no release, muzzle or bolt of its own.
material_overrides_note: As the Divine Staff's: steel's own 0.2 mirrors the scene.
tells_from: MU's own sentence for the Archangel's weapon, Game.en.resx:3049; the 'Quest item' line over it is ours (game/ui/describe.cpp).
chrome_from: RenderPartObjectBody (ZzzObject.cpp:7053-7058): mesh 0 (crossbow06_R) is drawn RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_METAL -- Shiny01 at RENDER_METAL's coordinates off the normal (ZzzBMD.cpp:1499-1502, 1683-1687), solid -- and then RENDER_LIGHTMAP with Chrome01 at its own UVs, V sliding at WorldTime*0.0001, a tenth of a sheet a second, which multiplies it: a polished sheen with chrome streaks running along it. Its own _R sheet is never drawn. Here the pass is Shiny01 times the sliding Chrome01 (its mask), added over the baked mesh rather than standing in for it (scrolls_per_second 0.1, the renderer's offset being minus the rate). pipeline/chrome_sheets.py.
